subject: PCA with asymmetric shape data from bilat.symmetry (matching symmmetry)

messages.author: c4e264f6ba017714
messages.subject: PCA with asymmetric shape data from bilat.symmetry (matching symmmetry)
parts:
Dear Geomorph Group Leads,

I am trying to run PCA with asymmetric component derived from bilat.symmetry implementation of matching symmetry analysis for the very first time.

My .TPS file do not have any missing values. However, when I looked into the asymmetric coordinates for each individual after bilat.symmetry analysis, I found that two individuals returned with NAs for all 11 landmarks I used. My first intuition is that there two individuals are absolutely symmetric such that they do not have any asymmetry. Am I correct in presuming it?

Secondly, since I would like to run PCA (with, say, plotTangentSpace) on the  asymmetric shape coordinates of individuals, is there a straight forward way to omit individuals with NA values? I could not find any solution on the net.

Regards
Rochishnu

messages.author: 511e44c7d1e1bab0
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] PCA with asymmetric shape data from bilat.symmetry (matching symmmetry)
parts:
Rochishnu,

in practice, there is no way you have mathematically absolutely symmetrical individuals, unless you did something weird with data collection. So it is strange that you are getting specimens with NAs I think... This might be a user-specific issue, difficult to address without looking at the data. If you want, send me your tps and script offline and I can have a look in the next days.

Cheers,

Antigoni
